scope: Seven final retained ideal-sensor cohorts; the discarded original lawnmower sweep is excluded.

definitions.primary_cell_belief_coverage_pct: 100 times fraction with any recorded first credit by tick 8000; retains the original primary outcome and includes post-death credit.
definitions.eventual_before_death_pct: 100 times fraction with first credit strictly before earliest retained trajectory state 3; equal death and credit ticks fail.
definitions.early_before_death_pct: 100 times fraction with first credit within 500 ticks of appearance and strictly before death.
definitions.penalized_first_credit_delay_ticks: Run mean of first-credit tick minus appearance for strict before-death credits; missing or post-death-only credits receive 8001 minus appearance.
definitions.timeliness_score_pct: 100*(8001-penalized_first_credit_delay_ticks)/8000. Affine restatement of the existing delay outcome, not independent supporting evidence; equals normalized area under the cumulative strict before-death first-credit curve on ticks 1..8000.
definitions.recorded_belief_uptime_pct: 100*sum(8001-first_detect_tick-total_tracking_gap_ticks)/(8000*persons), with never-credited persons contributing 0. Includes pre-first-credit absence, post-death states and recorder belief-proxy semantics; not continuous visual tracking or alive-only uptime.
definitions.untracked_danger_ticks_per_person: Recorded untracked active-fire ticks divided by total persons. Includes pre-first-credit absence and post-death states; not alive-only danger coverage. Danger threshold 0.5 acts on binary active fire.
definitions.first_fire_penalized_tick: First positive fire-observation tick or 8001 if absent. Measures first observed fire, not sustained fire monitoring.
definitions.fire_found_pct: 100 if any positive fire observation is recorded in run, otherwise 0.

aggregation: Equal-run means in each grid/regime stratum. All methods have identical scenario/regime keys. Each contrast pairs scenario and regime, averages differences within each seed, then uses a two-sided Student-t 95% interval across 15 seed means (seeds 27..41, df 14). Intervals are descriptive and unadjusted for multiple comparisons.
limitations: Recorded belief positivity/freshness is a cell-based proxy and may borrow evidence from nearby or previously occupied cells.
Uptime and danger include post-death records; alive-only continuous observation/danger exposure cannot be recovered from aggregate gap totals.
All first-credit measures are event summaries and do not establish visual person identification, rescue, survival improvements or sustained fire monitoring.
Several cohorts use different retained builds. Fully random also changes allocation policy; these matched contrasts do not isolate planner causality.
Compact scenario-person death records and source hashes support numerical replay; full source trajectories and per-tick belief states are not bundled here.
checks: Every raw persons.csv and summary.csv was read and hashed, every raw config was read and hashed, every source human trajectory was re-read and matched to pinned SHA-256; all per-run original coverage, before-death coverage, 500-tick recall, penalized delay, gaps, danger and distance values reproduce existing selected derived data.
